assumptions_verified: Badges are a pure function of EvidenceKind/CertificateStatus; import-time asserts cover every enum member
Only CertificateStatus.CERTIFIED maps to the green tone (tested over all enum members)
Simulated-origin and measured-origin badges have disjoint labels and CSS classes (+ dashed vs double border)
None bounds render 'no applicable bound', no <data> element; tiny bounds render in exponent form
ClaimPanel rejects raw numbers, numeric literals in statement text, dangling citations and unfilled placeholders
Site build is byte-deterministic (site_sha256 672d91a8...f83ea reproduced across two builds)
FIXTURE DATA label is fail-safe: on unless --real-data AND no SYNTHETIC record
interfaces_changed: None changed. Proposal (v2): add certificate_id to SecurityCertificate and certificate_ref to BenchmarkRecord so Pareto points can cite certificates without a configuration-dict convention; add record_id to ProtocolSpec.
known_limitations: All site content is SYNTHETIC fixture data; the numbers in tests/unit/ui/fixtures are invented for UI testing and are not research results
Theorem-card statements are transcribed from the frozen contract GameId comments, not re-verified against primary sources (lanes A/D)

No browser-based visual or automated WCAG audit was run (headless Chrome unavailable to the puppeteer tool); accessibility rests on semantic HTML, text badges, role=alert/note, svg title/desc, prefers-color-scheme
Record type is inferred from key signatures; a wrapper format with an explicit kind field would be more robust

Pareto view plots BenchmarkRecord photons_prepared vs security_target.epsilon_unf; a point counts as certified only if configuration.certificate_ref names a loaded CERTIFIED certificate (convention, not in contract)
Records without an id field (ProtocolSpec, SecurityCertificate) get id '<kind>:<file stem>'
Wave-1 views 'mint/test BB84 state' and interactive epsilon/constraint input are not implemented (static site)
